units.rawText: Still not going on the offense? You're more calm and collected than I had taken you for.

spans.text: Still not going on the offense? You're more calm and collected than I had taken you for.

units.rawText: As I tap the clock, Eucharist's time begins ticking down. She looks over the board as though observing a quaint instance of stagecraft.
units.displayText: As I tap the clock, Eucharist's time begins ticking down. She looks over the board as though observing a quaint instance of stagecraft.

spans.text: As I tap the clock, Eucharist's time begins ticking down. She looks over the board as though observing a quaint instance of stagecraft.

units.rawText: Defending your pawns? I see now... do you still plan to start with the communication nodes?
units.displayText: Defending your pawns? I see now... do you still plan to start with the communication nodes?

spans.text: Defending your pawns? I see now... do you still plan to start with the communication nodes?

units.rawText: You were the one telling me to pay attention.
units.displayText: You were the one telling me to pay attention.

spans.text: You were the one telling me to pay attention.

units.rawText: How composed. Still placid in these sorts of situations, as expected of the Professor.
units.displayText: How composed. Still placid in these sorts of situations, as expected of the Professor.

spans.text: How composed. Still placid in these sorts of situations, as expected of the Professor.

units.rawText: In that case, I'll be more than happy to take this bishop off you~
units.displayText: In that case, I'll be more than happy to take this bishop off you~

spans.text: In that case, I'll be more than happy to take this bishop off you~

units.rawText: Eucharist picks up the bishop, nonchalantly tossing it into her mouth.
units.displayText: Eucharist picks up the bishop, nonchalantly tossing it into her mouth.

spans.text: Eucharist picks up the bishop, nonchalantly tossing it into her mouth.

units.rawText: Krak.
units.displayText: Krak.

units.displayText: The piece cracks into shards and eventually thins down into powder, its original form long lost.

spans.text: The piece cracks into shards and eventually thins down into powder, its original form long lost.

units.rawText: Uhh...
units.displayText: Uhh...

spans.text: Uhh...

units.rawText: What, did that make you jump?
units.displayText: What, did that make you jump?

spans.text: What, did that make you jump?

units.rawText: No wonder you made these out of chocolate. How distasteful.
units.displayText: No wonder you made these out of chocolate. How distasteful.

spans.text: No wonder you made these out of chocolate. How distasteful.

units.rawText: Looks like I've been found out. They were specially prepared for this occasion, you know? Aren't they beautiful?
units.displayText: Looks like I've been found out. They were specially prepared for this occasion, you know? Aren't they beautiful?

spans.text: Looks like I've been found out. They were specially prepared for this occasion, you know? Aren't they beautiful?

units.rawText: Hehe, the first piece is always the most delicious. Were you worried if I was hungry, Professor? How profoundly thoughtful.
units.displayText: Hehe, the first piece is always the most delicious. Were you worried if I was hungry, Professor? How profoundly thoughtful.

spans.text: Hehe, the first piece is always the most delicious. Were you worried if I was hungry, Professor? How profoundly thoughtful.

units.rawText: It's a pity they're not as good as Choco's... sigh, I don't think I'll ever have a chance to taste that heaven again.
units.displayText: It's a pity they're not as good as Choco's... sigh, I don't think I'll ever have a chance to taste that heaven again.

spans.text: It's a pity they're not as good as Choco's... sigh, I don't think I'll ever have a chance to taste that heaven again.

units.rawText: Satisfied, Eucharist licks her lips, clapping her hands lightly. The circle of Entropics creeps forward somewhat, closing in.
units.displayText: Satisfied, Eucharist licks her lips, clapping her hands lightly. The circle of Entropics creeps forward somewhat, closing in.

spans.text: Satisfied, Eucharist licks her lips, clapping her hands lightly. The circle of Entropics creeps forward somewhat, closing in.

units.rawText: Entropic liquid had seeped out from the ground at some point, and I can now feel its touch on my leg.
units.displayText: Entropic liquid had seeped out from the ground at some point, and I can now feel its touch on my leg.

spans.text: Entropic liquid had seeped out from the ground at some point, and I can now feel its touch on my leg.

units.rawText: Eucharist! Cease these shenanigans.
units.displayText: Eucharist! Cease these shenanigans.

spans.text: Eucharist! Cease these shenanigans.

units.rawText: These are the rules of the game. Oh, did I forget to tell you about that?
units.displayText: These are the rules of the game. Oh, did I forget to tell you about that?

spans.text: These are the rules of the game. Oh, did I forget to tell you about that?

units.rawText: You must pay a price for losing a piece, though. I'm sure you understand, Professor.
units.displayText: You must pay a price for losing a piece, though. I'm sure you understand, Professor.

spans.text: You must pay a price for losing a piece, though. I'm sure you understand, Professor.

units.rawText: Eucharist casually swings her legs as she sits, seemingly expectant of an answer.
units.displayText: Eucharist casually swings her legs as she sits, seemingly expectant of an answer.

spans.text: Eucharist casually swings her legs as she sits, seemingly expectant of an answer.

units.rawText: With the ball in Eucharist's court, it's no surprise that she's willing to make maneuvers like this.
units.displayText: With the ball in Eucharist's court, it's no surprise that she's willing to make maneuvers like this.

spans.text: With the ball in Eucharist's court, it's no surprise that she's willing to make maneuvers like this.

units.rawText: But I have precious few reasons to say no.
units.displayText: But I have precious few reasons to say no.

spans.text: But I have precious few reasons to say no.

units.rawText: There must be stakes to a game. I am inclined to agree.
units.displayText: There must be stakes to a game. I am inclined to agree.

spans.text: There must be stakes to a game. I am inclined to agree.

units.rawText: Hehe, only you understand me such, Professor.
units.displayText: Hehe, only you understand me such, Professor.

spans.text: Hehe, only you understand me such, Professor.

units.rawText: Professor <cmdr>...
units.displayText: Professor {교수}...

spans.text: Professor

units.displayText: I raise a hand to stop Faith, who intended to approach.

units.rawText: And what if you lose a piece?
units.displayText: And what if you lose a piece?

spans.text: And what if you lose a piece?

units.rawText: Hm... if I lose a piece...
units.displayText: Hm... if I lose a piece...

spans.text: Hm... if I lose a piece...

units.rawText: Eucharist leans forward, interest brimming in her eyes.
units.displayText: Eucharist leans forward, interest brimming in her eyes.

spans.text: Eucharist leans forward, interest brimming in her eyes.

units.rawText: What would you want, Professor?
units.displayText: What would you want, Professor?

spans.text: What would you want, Professor?

units.rawText: For every piece I take from you, I am allowed to send one message. How about it? Simple enough.
units.displayText: For every piece I take from you, I am allowed to send one message. How about it? Simple enough.

spans.text: For every piece I take from you, I am allowed to send one message. How about it? Simple enough.

units.rawText: A tactical advantage in exchange for material, hm?
units.displayText: A tactical advantage in exchange for material, hm?

spans.text: A tactical advantage in exchange for material, hm?

units.rawText: A sporting suggestion, and one I can't reasonably refuse.
units.displayText: A sporting suggestion, and one I can't reasonably refuse.

spans.text: A sporting suggestion, and one I can't reasonably refuse.

units.rawText: I see we are both in favor of a fair match.
units.displayText: I see we are both in favor of a fair match.

spans.text: I see we are both in favor of a fair match.

units.rawText: After receiving affirmation, I pick up a white knight, capturing my opponent's pawn.
units.displayText: After receiving affirmation, I pick up a white knight, capturing my opponent's pawn.

spans.text: After receiving affirmation, I pick up a white knight, capturing my opponent's pawn.

units.rawText: ...Oh, I see. The conditions were simply not favorable enough for you to go on the offensive, Professor.
units.displayText: ...Oh, I see. The conditions were simply not favorable enough for you to go on the offensive, Professor.

spans.text: ...Oh, I see. The conditions were simply not favorable enough for you to go on the offensive, Professor.

units.rawText: Retracting her smile a bit, Eucharist returns to her formerly lackadaisical expression.
units.displayText: Retracting her smile a bit, Eucharist returns to her formerly lackadaisical expression.

spans.text: Retracting her smile a bit, Eucharist returns to her formerly lackadaisical expression.

units.rawText: As you said, then, Professor, we'll have a little intermission.
units.displayText: As you said, then, Professor, we'll have a little intermission.

spans.text: As you said, then, Professor, we'll have a little intermission.

units.rawText: According to my knowledge, you can't communicate with the Oasis yet, and the other sectors are occupied with self-preservation. Who do you have left to call on?
units.displayText: According to my knowledge, you can't communicate with the Oasis yet, and the other sectors are occupied with self-preservation. Who do you have left to call on?

spans.text: According to my knowledge, you can't communicate with the Oasis yet, and the other sectors are occupied with self-preservation. Who do you have left to call on?

units.rawText: Do you really think that I have no cards left to play without the Oasis? It appears you do not understand me as well as I thought you did.
units.displayText: Do you really think that I have no cards left to play without the Oasis? It appears you do not understand me as well as I thought you did.

spans.text: Do you really think that I have no cards left to play without the Oasis? It appears you do not understand me as well as I thought you did.

units.rawText: I take out my terminal, locating that familiar yet strange name.
units.displayText: I take out my terminal, locating that familiar yet strange name.

spans.text: I take out my terminal, locating that familiar yet strange name.

units.rawText: I'm <cmdr>, leader of the Oasis.
units.displayText: I'm {교수}, leader of the Oasis.

spans.text: I'm
, leader of the Oasis.

units.displayText: Null Area

choo!

units.rawText: The tan-haired girl finishes off the Entropic in front of her with a mighty robotic arm, unable to hold back a sneeze before she could even shake the being's liquids off her weapon.
units.displayText: The tan-haired girl finishes off the Entropic in front of her with a mighty robotic arm, unable to hold back a sneeze before she could even shake the being's liquids off her weapon.

spans.text: The tan-haired girl finishes off the Entropic in front of her with a mighty robotic arm, unable to hold back a sneeze before she could even shake the being's liquids off her weapon.

units.rawText: What's with you, Lind? Did you catch a cold, or are you allergic to Entropics?
units.displayText: What's with you, Lind? Did you catch a cold, or are you allergic to Entropics?

spans.text: What's with you, Lind? Did you catch a cold, or are you allergic to Entropics?

units.rawText: Dolls don't have these sorts of miscellaneous diseases. But you, have you caught a stupid disease or something with how much time you spend sleeping?
units.displayText: Dolls don't have these sorts of miscellaneous diseases. But you, have you caught a stupid disease or something with how much time you spend sleeping?

spans.text: Dolls don't have these sorts of miscellaneous diseases. But you, have you caught a stupid disease or something with how much time you spend sleeping?

units.rawText: Normal Dolls don't sneeze. With how unique your constitution is, who's to know just how similar you are to a human?
units.displayText: Normal Dolls don't sneeze. With how unique your constitution is, who's to know just how similar you are to a human?

spans.text: Normal Dolls don't sneeze. With how unique your constitution is, who's to know just how similar you are to a human?

units.rawText: Intent on hitting every taboo, Havoc? Arcadia must be truly starved for talent to send you with me.
units.displayText: Intent on hitting every taboo, Havoc? Arcadia must be truly starved for talent to send you with me.

spans.text: Intent on hitting every taboo, Havoc? Arcadia must be truly starved for talent to send you with me.

units.rawText: Even as they quarrel, Lind and Havoc's movements in combat flow as they always do. The other agents in the squad fend off the Entropics' attacks with practiced movements, as if this was a common occurrence for them.
units.displayText: Even as they quarrel, Lind and Havoc's movements in combat flow as they always do. The other agents in the squad fend off the Entropics' attacks with practiced movements, as if this was a common occurrence for them.

spans.text: Even as they quarrel, Lind and Havoc's movements in combat flow as they always do. The other agents in the squad fend off the Entropics' attacks with practiced movements, as if this was a common occurrence for them.

units.rawText: Yeah, yeah, okay. Why don't you tell me why you're sneezing, then?
units.displayText: Yeah, yeah, okay. Why don't you tell me why you're sneezing, then?

spans.text: Yeah, yeah, okay. Why don't you tell me why you're sneezing, then?

units.rawText: ...Someone's plotting against me.
units.displayText: ...Someone's plotting against me.

spans.text: ...Someone's plotting against me.

ha
ha
ha
ha
ha
ha
ha—

units.rawText: Ah, man, that woke me right up. UltiLife still keeps the good old tradition of feudal-era superstition, huh?

units.displayText: Shut up!

spans.text: Shut up!

units.rawText: Beeeeep—
units.displayText: Beeeeep—

spans.text: Beeeeep—

units.displayText: The ringing of her terminal cuts Lind off. She clicks her tongue in dissatisfaction and opens the message amidst the battle.

spans.text: The ringing of her terminal cuts Lind off. She clicks her tongue in dissatisfaction and opens the message amidst the battle.

units.rawText: What, is that some curse you were expecting to receive?
units.displayText: What, is that some curse you were expecting to receive?

spans.text: What, is that some curse you were expecting to receive?

units.rawText: Tch, much worse than a curse.
units.displayText: Tch, much worse than a curse.

spans.text: Tch, much worse than a curse.

units.rawText: Who knows how much sugar it's going to take to replenish the stamina I'll spend on this expedition.
units.displayText: Who knows how much sugar it's going to take to replenish the stamina I'll spend on this expedition.

spans.text: Who knows how much sugar it's going to take to replenish the stamina I'll spend on this expedition.

units.rawText: If I hadn't accepted this assignment to reinforce the Oasis, I'd probably be reminiscing about the midnight radio right now...
units.displayText: If I hadn't accepted this assignment to reinforce the Oasis, I'd probably be reminiscing about the midnight radio right now...

spans.text: If I hadn't accepted this assignment to reinforce the Oasis, I'd probably be reminiscing about the midnight radio right now...

units.rawText: Oh, stop it. Arcadia is dealing with Entropic attacks right now, too. Just which timeline's radio are you going to listen to?
units.displayText: Oh, stop it. Arcadia is dealing with Entropic attacks right now, too. Just which timeline's radio are you going to listen to?

spans.text: Oh, stop it. Arcadia is dealing with Entropic attacks right now, too. Just which timeline's radio are you going to listen to?

units.rawText: I'd say you should give up and face reality. Was that something from Boss? Or...

spans.text: I'd say you should give up and face reality. Was that something from Boss? Or...

units.rawText: Sigh...
units.displayText: Sigh...

spans.text: Sigh...

units.rawText: Oh no, seriously?
units.displayText: Oh no, seriously?

spans.text: Oh no, seriously?

units.rawText: Is it something direct from that "Professor"?
units.displayText: Is it something direct from that "Professor"?

spans.text: Is it something direct from that "Professor"?

units.rawText: ...More work to do. We'll move the moment we're done with this batch.
units.displayText: ...More work to do. We'll move the moment we're done with this batch.

spans.text: ...More work to do. We'll move the moment we're done with this batch.

units.rawText: Huh? Not going to the Oasis anymore?
units.displayText: Huh? Not going to the Oasis anymore?

spans.text: Huh? Not going to the Oasis anymore?

units.rawText: Shouldn't you be happy about that? From what I know, you're rather inclined towards avoiding a few individuals there.

spans.text: Shouldn't you be happy about that? From what I know, you're rather inclined towards avoiding a few individuals there.

units.rawText: Lind does not answer, but she places more and more force into her strikes.
units.displayText: Lind does not answer, but she places more and more force into her strikes.

spans.text: Lind does not answer, but she places more and more force into her strikes.

units.rawText: Oh, come on, I'm just saying!
units.displayText: Oh, come on, I'm just saying!

spans.text: Oh, come on, I'm just saying!

units.rawText: This isn't like you. Did you get your head put on upside down when you went to Ascension?
units.displayText: This isn't like you. Did you get your head put on upside down when you went to Ascension?

spans.text: This isn't like you. Did you get your head put on upside down when you went to Ascension?

units.rawText: Havoc seemed to hit some keywords, bits, and pieces of the past floating up in Lind's neural cloud.
units.displayText: Havoc seemed to hit some keywords, bits, and pieces of the past floating up in Lind's neural cloud.

spans.text: Havoc seemed to hit some keywords, bits, and pieces of the past floating up in Lind's neural cloud.

units.rawText: Mulling over those scenes countless times gave her the resolve in this moment.
units.displayText: Mulling over those scenes countless times gave her the resolve in this moment.

spans.text: Mulling over those scenes countless times gave her the resolve in this moment.

units.rawText: ...I just thought that I couldn't keep running away from the past like this.
units.displayText: ...I just thought that I couldn't keep running away from the past like this.

spans.text: ...I just thought that I couldn't keep running away from the past like this.

units.rawText: Then Sueyoi and De Lacey would've worked for nothing.
units.displayText: Then Sueyoi and De Lacey would've worked for nothing.

spans.text: Then Sueyoi and De Lacey would've worked for nothing.

units.rawText: Woah, that's something you're actually capable of saying? If De Lacey heard that, she'd be all over you, bawling her eyes out.
units.displayText: Woah, that's something you're actually capable of saying? If De Lacey heard that, she'd be all over you, bawling her eyes out.

spans.text: Woah, that's something you're actually capable of saying? If De Lacey heard that, she'd be all over you, bawling her eyes out.

units.rawText: Screw that! ...Gah, the thought of that gives me goosebumps. Makes me feel all queasy, too.

spans.text: Screw that! ...Gah, the thought of that gives me goosebumps. Makes me feel all queasy, too.

units.rawText: Looking at it from "N"'s perspective, though, they're bound to think that you and Persicaria are old acquaintances and want to use this to gain the upper hand in negotiations. That's the whole reason this was assigned to you, Isn't it?
units.displayText: Looking at it from "N"'s perspective, though, they're bound to think that you and Persicaria are old acquaintances and want to use this to gain the upper hand in negotiations. That's the whole reason this was assigned to you, Isn't it?

units.rawText: Probably.
units.displayText: Probably.

units.rawText: You're not pissed?
units.displayText: You're not pissed?

spans.text: You're not pissed?

units.rawText: What's there to be pissed about? You use what tools you have available. It's not like I'll sandbag.
units.displayText: What's there to be pissed about? You use what tools you have available. It's not like I'll sandbag.

spans.text: What's there to be pissed about? You use what tools you have available. It's not like I'll sandbag.

units.rawText: If you say so, we're almost done here. What's the "Professor" doing, anyway?
units.displayText: If you say so, we're almost done here. What's the "Professor" doing, anyway?

spans.text: If you say so, we're almost done here. What's the "Professor" doing, anyway?

units.displayText: Lind chucks away a final Entropic corpse, cleaning the liquid off her gear as she peels away the wrapper on another lollipop.

spans.text: Lind chucks away a final Entropic corpse, cleaning the liquid off her gear as she peels away the wrapper on another lollipop.

units.rawText: Lemme see... closest to here is Backup Communications Node 02.
units.displayText: Lemme see... closest to here is Backup Communications Node 02.

spans.text: Lemme see... closest to here is Backup Communications Node 02.

units.rawText: They're making us fix up comms? Crap, I'd rather deal with the Entropics! Repairing something's way harder than smashing it up.
units.displayText: They're making us fix up comms? Crap, I'd rather deal with the Entropics! Repairing something's way harder than smashing it up.

spans.text: They're making us fix up comms? Crap, I'd rather deal with the Entropics! Repairing something's way harder than smashing it up.

units.rawText: We'll have to put up with it this one time. The positions of the nodes that require repair have been sent through to everyone.

spans.text: We'll have to put up with it this one time. The positions of the nodes that require repair have been sent through to everyone.

units.rawText: Ohhh, that building over there, right? Whew, it sure looks messed up. Can we really fix—
units.displayText: Ohhh, that building over there, right? Whew, it sure looks messed up. Can we really fix—

spans.text: Ohhh, that building over there, right? Whew, it sure looks messed up. Can we really fix—

units.rawText: Stop complaining. This has to be done. Fast.
units.displayText: Stop complaining. This has to be done. Fast.

spans.text: Stop complaining. This has to be done. Fast.

units.displayText: Lind looks all around, and her eyes landing on the path toward Communications Node 04.

spans.text: Lind looks all around, and her eyes landing on the path toward Communications Node 04.

units.rawText: For whatever reason, she feels something drawing her toward it, yet her instincts scream danger.
units.displayText: For whatever reason, she feels something drawing her toward it, yet her instincts scream danger.

spans.text: For whatever reason, she feels something drawing her toward it, yet her instincts scream danger.

units.rawText: What is it, Lind? Get a move on. Are you feeling like sneezing again?

spans.text: What is it, Lind? Get a move on. Are you feeling like sneezing again?
